**sdd/issue-231-cp-a2b-fix/apply-progress**

**What**: Fixed CP-A2b live-validation findings #12 and #13 on branch fix/issue-231-cp-a2b-ci-portability. Commit 6965052.

**Why**: Live validation against the gitlab.com mirror surfaced two CI-portability bugs in the GitLab governance pipeline fragment (brain/scripts/ci/gitlab-governance.yml): (#13) `node --test "brain/scripts/**/*.test.mjs"` needs Node 21+ glob expansion, but the fragment pinned node:20 per-job → local-checks failed "Could not find ..."; (#12) providers/gitlab.mjs's issueView shelled out to the `glab` CLI, absent from the node:22 image, crashing the REQUIRED issue-link gate's defaultFetchIssue on every MR (an INFRA trigger masquerading as a governance failure).

**Where**:
- `brain/scripts/ci/gitlab-governance.yml` — removed per-job `image: node:20` (8x), added ONE global `default: image: node:22` block.
- `brain/scripts/vcs/ci-context-drift-guard.test.mjs` — new test asserting the global node:22+ pin exists and no job carries its own `image:` line (downgrade-to-node:20 turns RED, sanity-verified); fixed `extractGitlabJobNames` to exclude the new reserved `default:` top-level key (would have false-positived as a 9th "job").
- `brain/scripts/vcs/gitlab-api.mjs` (NEW) — shared PURE GitLab REST v4 fetch helper `gitlabApiFetch({apiBase, token, proxyUrl, path, fetchImpl})`. No env reads inside — not a GATE_FILE member by construction.
- `brain/scripts/vcs/ci-context.mjs` — extracted `gitlabApiConfig(deps)` export (sole sanctioned resolver of {apiBase, token, proxyUrl} from CI_API_V4_URL/VCS_TOKEN/HTTPS_PROXY); refactored `defaultFetchMr` to consume the shared `gitlabApiFetch` helper (no behavior change, REQ-CIC-5 tests stay green).
- `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/gitlab.mjs` — `issueView` migrated from `runJson('glab', ['api', ...])` to `gitlabApiFetch` with `{apiBase, token, proxyUrl, fetchImpl}` threaded in as parameters (never reads process.env.CI_API_V4_URL directly — gitlab.mjs is a GATE_FILE). Defaults preserve local/non-CI callers (ticket-start.mjs, brain-start.mjs): apiBase defaults to public gitlab.com, token defaults via existing `vcsToken(PROVIDER)`. issueList/mrList/etc. NOT migrated (local-interactive glab session auth, A3 territory).
- `brain/scripts/governance/run-check.mjs` — `defaultFetchIssue(ctx)` now calls `gitlabApiConfig()` (imported from ci-context.mjs) and threads `{apiBase, token, proxyUrl}` into `vcs.issueView(...)`. github.mjs's issueView ignores the extra keys, so this is safe for both providers.
- Test files updated/added: `gitlab-api.test.mjs` (new, 6 tests), `ci-context.test.mjs` (+5 tests for gitlabApiConfig), `providers.test.mjs` (+3: direct-fetch shape test replacing the old glab-spawn fixture, local-default-apiBase test, CLI-free proof test asserting issueView never calls spawn), `run-check.test.mjs` (+1 source-wiring test proving defaultFetchIssue threads apiBase/token/proxyUrl and never reads CI_API_V4_URL directly), `ci-context-drift-guard.test.mjs` (+1 node:22+ pin test).

**Learned**:
- The drift-guard's PIPELINE_ENV_PATTERN regex scans full file source text, including comments/JSDoc — writing `process.env.CI_API_V4_URL` literally in a docstring (even to describe what NOT to do) trips the guard. Had to reword documentation to say "the GitLab API base URL pipeline var" instead of the literal env-var-prefixed string, in both gitlab.mjs and run-check.mjs.
- `extractGitlabJobNames` in ci-context-drift-guard.test.mjs matches any zero-indent `word:` YAML key as a "job name" (only excludes leading-dot template keys) — introducing a global `default:` top-level key required extending its exclusion list, otherwise the existing GOVERNANCE_JOBS-equality test would have false-positived on "default" as an unrecognized 9th job.
- `defaultFetchIssue` in run-check.mjs is deliberately never exercised with real network in tests (design.md Decision 2) — verified its wiring correctness via a source-level assertion (matches the project's own established pattern for this class of untestable-without-network glue, e.g. ci-context.test.mjs's "proxy read from standard env" test).
- Full `npm test`: 1146/1146 passing (baseline was 1132; +14 net new tests). Drift-guard green — verified zero forbidden pipeline-env-var reads in gitlab.mjs, run-check.mjs, and gitlab-api.mjs.
- brain/core/ untouched throughout (constraint honored) — vcs-contract.md's issueView signature `({project, number}) -> {...}` still holds; new params are additive/optional.

TDD Cycle Evidence:
| Unit | RED confirmed | GREEN confirmed | REFACTOR |
|---|---|---|---|
| #13 node:22 pin drift-guard | yes (assertion failed: no `default:` block) | yes (25/25 in drift-guard file) | extractGitlabJobNames exclusion fix |
| gitlab-api.mjs shared helper | yes (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND) | yes (6/6) | n/a |
| gitlabApiConfig() export | yes (SyntaxError: no export) | yes (34/34 ci-context.test.mjs) | defaultFetchMr refactored to reuse gitlabApiFetch, tests stayed green |
| gitlab.mjs issueView direct-fetch | yes (3 tests failed against glab-spawn impl) | yes (56/56 providers.test.mjs) | n/a |
| run-check.mjs defaultFetchIssue wiring | yes (assertion: apiBase/token/proxyUrl not threaded) | yes (53/53 run-check.test.mjs) | reworded 2 docstrings to avoid drift-guard false-positive on literal env-var text |

Status: both findings closed. Single commit 6965052 on fix/issue-231-cp-a2b-ci-portability. Not pushed, no PR (per instructions).
